title: libcuflynx supermodule parameters (<module_type>_<module_subtype>_parameters.json; a model's <prefix>_supermodule_parameters/<instance>.json)
description: The parameter values of a supermodule's instances: a version's file, beside its module array (<module_type>_<module_subtype>_module_array.json) and config, is the template a new instance is copied from; a model's supermodule instance has its own, <prefix>_supermodule_parameters/<instance>.json beside the model's module array, which is what generation reads. It names every instance of the version's module array once. An instance's parameter <var> becomes {var}_<record>__<instance>. The supermodule's parameterisation (the host record's, or its default_parameterisation; globals only) and the host parameters file are read over them; a parameter the file does not give comes from the instance's version's default parameterisation. cuflynx-upgrade module-config writes a version's file when it converts a supermodule, and cuflynx-upgrade supermodule-instances a model's instance files. Read by libcuflynx/utilities/config_schemas.py (read_supermodule_parameters_file).

instances.description: Required. {instance name: its parameters}, one entry for each record of the supermodule's module array.

parameterisation.description: Required. The parameterisation of the instance's version its values started from: "default" (the version's default_parameterisation) or the name of another of its parameterisations. A record of where the values came from; generation reads the values in "parameters".

parameters.description: Required. {variable: value}. A component instance's are its own variables ("E_A"); a supermodule instance's are paths into it ("i_M/g_M"), which override its own version's file. Globals are set by the supermodule's parameterisation, not here.

value.description: Required. The value, as a parameters CSV's value column holds it.

units.description: Required. Its units, as in a parameters CSV.

data_reference.description: Where the value comes from, as in a parameters CSV. Default: empty.

parameter.description: One parameter: a parameters CSV row's columns. Other string keys (a module library's "sourced") are kept and not read.
